title: Thai-Style Egg Frittata
description: A fusion twist on the classic frittata, infused with Thai flavors and spices.
instructions: 2. In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
3. Add cooked chorizo and cook for 2-3 minutes, until crispy.
4. In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, jammy jus, and a pinch of salt.
5. Add diced jalapeño and chopped cilantro to the egg mixture and stir.
6. Pour the egg mixture over the cooked chorizo and stir gently.
7. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the eggs are set.
8. Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
9. Slice into wedges and serve hot.
10. Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
